home.heroDescription: A community sports organization bringing together sports enthusiasts in {neighborhood}, {city} since {year}.
home.asadMeaning: Association Sportive des Amis du Developpement
home.asadTranslation: Sports Association of Friends of Development
home.storyP1: ASAD is more than just a sports club. We are a family of friends united by our love for football and our commitment to community development. Founded in {year} in {neighborhood}, we have grown to become a pillar of our community.
home.storyP2: Our mission extends beyond the football pitch. Through various programs, we support education, promote financial discipline, and provide a safety net for our members in times of need.
home.communityProgramsDescription: Beyond sports, we invest in our community through various programs that support members and their families.
home.capturingMomentsDescription: From match days to community events, browse through our memories.
home.joinFamilyDescription: Become part of a community that values sports, unity, and mutual support. Whether you're a football enthusiast or looking for a supportive community, ASAD welcomes you.

about.title: About ASAD
about.description: Discover the story behind the Association Sportive des Amis du Developpement and our commitment to community development.
about.coreValuesDescription: Our core values guide everything we do at ASAD.
about.missionDescription: To promote sports, unity, and community development through football and social programs that support our members and their families.
about.visionDescription: To be a model community organization that demonstrates how sports can transform lives and strengthen communities.
about.valuesDescription: Unity, sportsmanship, mutual support, transparency, and commitment to community development guide everything we do.
about.commitmentDescription: We are committed to providing a supportive environment where members can grow, compete, and contribute to the community.
